report.previous_run_delta: New: Zoho launched Catalyst 3.0 on September 2 with an agent-ready full-stack platform, a recurring monthly free tier, and an optional $250 six-month credit requiring a payment method. Recovered: Deepgram combines $200 no-card signup credit with an application-only startup program advertising up to $100,000; Flux TTS is free through September 12. Recovered: AssemblyAI offers $50 non-expiring signup credits and a bootstrapped-friendly startup program with 12 months of recurring credits, but does not disclose the amount. Closing: WebMCP submissions are due September 3 at 1 p.m. PT. Unchanged/not recycled: Cloudflare's $10,000 Tier 3, AMD Developer Cloud, and Astra/Daybreak.

signals.changed: Recovered a layered voice-infrastructure subsidy: $200 standard signup credit without a card, Flux TTS free through September 12, and an application-only startup path advertising up to $100,000 for 12 months.
signals.free_value: $200 standard credit; at the current $0.0043/min Nova-3 pre-recorded rate this is roughly 775 hours. Flux TTS is free until September 12. Accepted startup applicants may receive up to $100,000, but Deepgram controls the amount and timing.
signals.fit: Zero-card entry is solo-builder accessible. The startup program requires an AI builder or early-stage startup in production or launching within six months and active community participation.
signals.catch: Startup approval and award size are discretionary; credits expire 12 months after issue, work only on Pay As You Go, follow the standard signup credits, are project-tied, and exclude competitor research. Do not start the one-year clock without a plausible voice workload.

signals.changed: Zoho launched Catalyst 3.0 on September 2 with MCP, agent skills, AI-IDE integration, scoped agent permissions, audit trails, and a full-stack cloud surface.
signals.free_value: An auto-renewing monthly free tier across functions, database, object storage, CDN hosting, SmartBrowz, and other components. Current examples include 25,000 function GB-seconds, 500 PDF conversions, 5 GB Data Store, 5 GB object storage, and 300,000 frontend CDN requests per month. A separate one-time $250 credit lasts six months.
signals.fit: Account-level free tier is accessible without an incorporation or funding gate found on the pricing surface. It can host bounded experiments and agent-built applications.
signals.catch: A payment method is required to claim the $250 credit, after which normal billing applies at expiry. Free quotas are shared across usage dimensions and do not justify migrating the current Cloudflare plan or delaying the WebMCP submission.

signals.changed: Recovered a second voice-program surface: new accounts receive non-expiring credits, and bootstrapped through Series A startups can apply for 12 months of recurring credits and engineering guidance.
signals.free_value: $50 of non-expiring signup credits for STT, streaming STT, Voice Agent API, Speech Understanding, and Guardrails; startup-program amount is not public.
signals.fit: Bootstrapped teams are explicitly welcome, but the product must center voice/audio and be in production or launching within six months. A work email and company name are requested.
signals.catch: LLM Gateway is excluded. The undisclosed startup amount prevents magnitude verification, and there is no reason to divert work absent a real voice product.
